en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground there are ploughed fields sloping down toward a body of water, with a seated person near the shore. Across the lake stands a long pavilion‑like building with a pointed spire or small tower. Behind it are wooded hills, with a structure on top of a hill to the left and a house on a hillside to the right. Printed caption text in red is at the bottom center, and a small number appears at the lower left.
